components_strategy.buttons: Always use fully rounded corners (rounded-full) for primary actions to contrast with the 3xl card corners. Primary button is yellow-400 with black text. WhatsApp button must use green-500.
components_strategy.cards: Use zinc-900 with zinc-800 borders, rounded-3xl. Add the yellow hover glow (hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(250,204,21,0.3)]) on interactive cards (like dashboard stats or selectable proposals).
components_strategy.tables: Go cardless or place within a rounded-3xl container. Use zinc-800 for table header borders and zinc-800/50 for row borders. Ensure text contrast is high.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn components heavily customized. Inputs should have zinc-900 background, zinc-800 border, rounded-xl. Focus state: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-yellow-400 focus:border-yellow-400.
components_strategy.modals: Use Shadcn dialog. Background zinc-950, border zinc-800, rounded-3xl.
components_strategy.charts: Use Shadcn charts (Recharts). Primary bar/line color should be yellow-400 (#FACC15), secondary can be zinc-600.

icons.style: duotone or regular, depending on emphasis

media_urls.description: Obelisco Radical official logo. Use in sidebar, header, login page, and PDF exports.
Dark electrical engineering background. Use for the login page right/left split screen to give it an industrial feel. Add a heavy overlay (e.g. bg-zinc-950/80) to ensure text readability if overlaid.

accessibility_and_motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have explicit hover text/bg colors. e.g. hover:text-yellow-400.
accessibility_and_motion.transitions: Use transition-all duration-300 ease-out for buttons, cards, and links.
accessibility_and_motion.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, inputs, and key data points (e.g. data-testid='login-button', data-testid='metric-total-obras').

specific_instructions_for_main_agent: Force dark mode by adding 'dark' class to the root or html tag, or by modifying tailwind.config.js default theme. The user specifically requested a dark layout.
All headings must be uppercase and font-black (e.g. font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white).
The primary accent color is yellow-400 (#FACC15). Use it for primary buttons, active links, and chart highlights.
Make sure cards use rounded-3xl and have the yellow hover glow effect.
Ensure the PDF Export feature uses the logo media url provided.
Use '@phosphor-icons/react' for icons. You will need to install it: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react.
In tailwind.config.js, update colors to map primary to yellow-400, background to zinc-950, card to zinc-900, border to zinc-800, etc.
